author: opencode-worker-2
text: Scope correction (worker-2 round-16 probe): there is NO beacon RX path in C to wire into — lichen_ccp_fsm_event has zero callers outside tdma.c, no beacon frame parsing exists in lichen_link_rx.c, and lichen_link_set_slot is never called. The integration is a feature (beacon frame parse + authentication + FSM drive + superframe tick), not wiring. Decompose before touching code: (a) beacon frame parse/auth in link RX, (b) FSM drive from the parsed beacon (thin — FSM core landed in b7z9.12.1), (c) superframe tick source + tdma->synced sync. Releasing to the pool for decomposition.
